Class AdminController

java.lang.Object
at.qe.skeleton.controllers.AdminController
@RestController @RequestMapping("/api/admin") public class AdminController extends Object
REST controllers for admin users. This class is part of the skeleton project provided for students of the course "Software Engineering" offered by Innsbruck University.

    • updateUser

      @PatchMapping("/{id}") public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<UserxDTO> updateUser(@PathVariable Long id, @Valid @RequestBody @Valid UserxUpdateDTO userxDto)
      Partially updates the user with a given id. The update is partial because only a select subset of user fields can be modified after creation.
      Parameters:
      id - the id of the user to be updated
      userxDto - the updated user information
      Returns:
      ResponseEntity with status 201 (Created) with the updated user in the body, or with status 404 (Not Found) if no user with this id exists
